description: Release work orders, travelers, and work instructions through MES; send NC programs to about 1,150 CNC machines through DNC at FL-2, TX-1, and AL-1
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 38% of daily shipments come from machined parts; prime on-time delivery ratings; machines finish loaded jobs for about one shift; a wrong NC program revision can scrap titanium stock or crash a machine
manual_workaround: Controlled printed job packets; machines finish loaded jobs; no new setups until MES returns and the program revision is checked against PLM
dependent_systems: SYS-06 MES and DNC; SYS-04 PLM; SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Machine tool manufacturers (remote support); SD-WAN carriers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Machine operators; Director of OT Engineering; FL-2, TX-1, AL-1 shop floors
quantified_impact_basis: About 38% of $19.2 million daily shipments deferred
single_points_of_failure: Central MES instance (DC-1, standby in DC-2)

description: Ply cutting, layup, autoclave cure, and trim of composite wing and fuselage panels at GA-1
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Prepreg material has limited out-time; an autoclave run lost mid-cycle scraps the load (about $400,000 a run); panels feed AL-1 assembly within days
manual_workaround: Paper cure records from the autoclave chart recorders; hold layup until MES returns
dependent_systems: SYS-06 MES; autoclave controllers (Specialized Assets); SYS-04 PLM
quantified_impact_basis: Deferred panel deliveries plus scrapped material
single_points_of_failure: 2 autoclaves with controllers on an unsupported operating system

business_process: Final assembly and delivery of structural assemblies
description: Assembly of wing and fuselage sections at AL-1 for Prime A and Prime C
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract delivery schedules carry liquidated damages after 5 days late; work in progress stays on fixtures
manual_workaround: Paper travelers from controlled job packets; continue work on fixtures
dependent_systems: SYS-06 MES; SYS-04 PLM viewing stations; SYS-07
dependent_third_parties: Prime A and Prime C delivery portals
quantified_impact_basis: About 21% of daily shipments deferred; liquidated damages after 5 days
single_points_of_failure: Single assembly site for Prime A wing sections

description: Build preparation, metal powder bed fusion printing on 36 printers, and post-processing at AZ-1
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Builds take 1 to 4 days; a running build continues without network; new builds need released build files from PLM
manual_workaround: Printers finish running builds; release no new builds until build files are verified against PLM
dependent_systems: SYS-06 build-prep workstations and printers; SYS-04 PLM
dependent_third_parties: Printer manufacturers (remote support; one tool outside PAM)

description: First article inspection, CMM inspection, nonconformance records, and certificates of conformance at every plant
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: No part ships without acceptance records; a corrupted inspection record could let a nonconforming flight part reach an aircraft; prime quality clauses and AS9100 require records
manual_workaround: Manual inspection with calibrated hand gauges for simple features; paper inspection records entered later; hold parts that need CMM programs
dependent_systems: SYS-06 MES and CMMs; quality management system (DC-1); SYS-04 PLM
quantified_impact_basis: About 60% of daily shipments wait on electronic acceptance records
single_points_of_failure: Quality management system single instance in DC-1 (standby DC-2)

description: Receive prime models; create and revise drawings; release engineering changes in PLM
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Released jobs keep running; changes wait; program milestones are measured in days
manual_workaround: Work locally on CAD workstations and check in later; no new releases until PLM returns
dependent_third_parties: Government-community cloud provider; PLM and CAD software vendors
dependent_people_or_facilities: About 1,400 design engineers; FL-1 engineering center
quantified_impact_basis: Idle engineering time plus program milestone slips

description: Create and prove NC programs and additive build files from released models
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: New part numbers and engineering changes wait; proven programs already in DNC keep running
manual_workaround: Use proven programs already in DNC; defer new programs
dependent_systems: SYS-04 PLM; SYS-03 virtual desktops; SYS-05; SYS-06 DNC
dependent_people_or_facilities: About 260 NC programmers and manufacturing engineers

business_process: Contracts, export compliance, and DoD incident reporting
